### The Ark Comes to the Temple
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/ark-comes-to-the-temple
Passage: 2 Chronicles 5:1–6:11
Points:
- Solomon brought the dedicated treasures and the ark of the covenant into the newly finished temple in Jerusalem.
- The installation of the ark was celebrated with countless sacrifices and united music from Levitical singers and trumpeting priests.
- God showed His pleasure and presence as the visible cloud of His glory filled the house of the Lord.
- Solomon announced to the assembly that God had faithfully fulfilled His promise to David by establishing Solomon's reign and completing the temple.
- Although the Creator cannot be contained by any structure, Christians can be confident of His special presence whenever they gather for worship.
